# Pinned source input for a compile-only checkpoint

The archive contains the already inspected public AWS ClockBound revision
371058f8f6a1786d4a4ab3eed9f5f2f16eea7777, preserved locally without source changes.
It is a locally regenerated backup, not the original HTTPS transport response.
SHA256:468fde829962d7c2a9fbb9cb981c07ccc2e44c34eed48d43dafce95bda2c2f02.

UPSTREAM-TREE.json is the exact saved upstream recursive Git-tree response.
The bounded materializer verifies all322regular blobs, then applies ONLY the
separate reviewed precise-origin patch and adds the actual adapter module.
No source file is extracted as executable; upstream build/install/RPM workflows
are not invoked. Both original MIT and Apache-2.0 notices accompany this input.

This is a prerelease test candidate, not an adopted or qualified production
runtime. Locked registry dependencies/build scripts/proc macros execute only
within the separately approved compile checkpoint. No daemon/output is launched.
